dagoste-squadra-migliora.description: Improve a project's development workflow from observed failures, repeated work and avoidable waits. Apply scoped, verified remedies and useful project instructions, then automatically commit owned changes when the project's required checks and reviews are complete. Use after recurring development friction or when asked to improve the process; do not add rules without evidence.

dagoste-squadra-root.description: Coordinates work entrusted to several Codex, Claude, Cursor or mixed windows, with tasks, acknowledgements, proofs, a non-author reviewer and a persistent registry. Includes squadra dash to view the activity and squadra selftest to test the protocol. Use when the owner asks for a squad (squadra), a coordinator/builders/reviewer, resuming a squad or its dashboard; it does not impose this scheme on ordinary changes in a single window.
